Buy a ID Card on Telegram

A id card is not one product. It is a data page, a number, a feature set and a register entry, and sellers price each layer differently. the national issuing authority issues the real thing.

Issuing authority
Varies by country, always a government office. Named on every country page.
Observed price band

Typical delivery
3 to 28 days, tracked
What it proves
An ID card is a domestic identity document issued by a civil registry, police force or municipal office. It proves identity inside the country and usually nothing outside it.

buy id card on telegram – the short version

A id card is checked in five minutes by anybody who knows what the national issuing authority prints. Ghost image, microprint, machine-readable zone, laminate edge, UV response. A seller with real stock will not mind you asking.

None of these checks need equipment beyond a loupe and a UV torch. Both cost less than the deposit on a single document and both last for years of buying.

For a id card the realistic expectation is 240 USD and one to three weeks of waiting. Same day delivery at the bottom of the band usually means a digital file rather than a card.

buy id card via telegram: how it works in practice

A serious seller of ID Cards will send an uncropped photo of the card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame. Screenshots and cropped data pages are where problems hide.

When a seller is good, say so and keep them. A reliable contact in this market is worth more than a small saving, and repeat buyers get the better stock.

A seller who handles ID Cards well names the national issuing authority without prompting. If the authority only appears after you mention it, the seller is repeating your words back at you.

What you should actually receive

A complete id card is a set of things, not a single image. Insist on all five before any money moves.

  • A card with your photo, full name, date of birth and a document number.
  • The issuing office name and the issue and expiry dates.
  • The security features the issuing office uses, from chip to UV print to guilloche pattern.
  • A number that follows the national numbering rule, check digit included where one exists.
  • Any companion record the country keeps, such as a register entry or a chip read.

Who actually issues a id card

The id card sits under the national issuing authority and that office number format is published widely enough to test. A number that breaks the format is the fastest single proof that something is wrong.

That is why the authority question comes before the price question. A seller who knows the office knows the stock, and a seller who knows the stock can tell you what the number should look like.

Replica or registered original

Ask the direct question in writing: does the number resolve at the office, yes or no. A seller who says yes and hedges is selling stock. A seller who says no and prices accordingly is honest.

Where the country has no public register route, the tier question becomes harder to prove. In those cases, buy stock at the middle of the band and do not pay top-tier prices on an unprovable claim.

What a fair price looks like

You will see ID Cards below 240 USD described as original. Sometimes they are. More often a print has been priced and given a word it has not earned.

If a quote is far above the band, ask what the extra buys. A register check, a replacement guarantee and tracked delivery justify the top. Confidence alone does not.

The buying process, step by step

Six steps, in this order. The order matters more than any single step.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the national issuing authority.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the national issuing authority uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 240 USD band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

Every check here targets something a seller cannot fake without real stock or real equipment.

  • Test the number against the national algorithm. Most ID numbers carry a check digit.
  • Read the chip where one exists, with the official national app if there is one.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a clean seal rather than a cut line.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the national issuing authority. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

If you see any of these, stop paying attention to the price.

  • A card with a chip contact plate that no reader can read.
  • Round or repeating digits in the number, such as a birth date followed by 0000.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

How much is an ID card on Telegram?

Between 90 and 500 US dollars. A print sits at the bottom, a chip card with a valid number at the top.

Is an ID card worth buying at all?

It is the cheapest document to fake convincingly, so it is also the one most often faked badly. Buy it only with a number check.

Do ID cards work abroad?

Inside the issuing country, yes. Outside it, most are only accepted as secondary evidence.

What is the giveaway on a fake ID?

The number. It is the one part that has to obey a rule, and sellers who invent numbers rarely know the rule.

Can I check an ID number myself?

In most countries yes, because the algorithm is published. Search for the country name and check digit.

Before you pay

If you have a id card in front of you and something feels off, compare it against the list above before you send anything.
